svg.text: EKS Production Platform: how the resources connect
One AWS account (eu-west-2), two Terraform stacks, GitHub for CI, Argo CD for delivery.
NS records delegate lab. to Route53

g.text: bootstrap/ stack: permanent, applied by hand
terraform/ stack: platform, built and destroyed by the pipelines
Private subnets 10.0.0.0/19 ×3 (pod IPs from the VPC CNI) · managed node group: 2× t4g.medium Graviton, AL2023 arm64
Prometheus scrapes every namespace through ServiceMonitors; Grafana and Argo CD are reached only with kubectl port-forward.

svg.text: identity (GitHub OIDC, IRSA): short-lived credentials, no stored keys

1–3 request path · 4 ExternalDNS keeps Route53 in sync · 5 cert-manager proves the domain · 6–7 Argo CD pulls desired state · 8 GitHub assumes IAM roles · 9 the apply role builds the platform stack · 10 ExternalDNS gets Route53 rights
